manual_review.text: Coverage currently spans India (TKDL, CGPDTM, Ayush, NBA) and the principal international systems (WIPO, EPO, USPTO, Nagoya Protocol). National-phase detail for other jurisdictions is summarised from WIPO aggregates and may lag local amendments.

Patent screening, TKDL cross-referencing, fee estimation, and jurisdictional orientation remain automated and citation-grounded. Escalation is additive — it never replaces the transparent evidence layer.
